representative_tasks.task: Build an augmentation pipeline for an object-detection dataset with bounding boxes
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Albumentations Compose with bbox_params (pascal_voc, label_fields, min_visibility) so boxes move with the image; float [0, 1] inputs and no ImageNet Normalize for torchvision detectors; an empty-box image still yields a (0, 4) target

representative_tasks.task: Fine-tune a COCO-pretrained Faster R-CNN on three custom classes
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Replaces only the box predictor with FastRCNNPredictor(in_features, num_classes + 1 for background), labels start at 1, tuple-collating DataLoader, training loop that stops on a non-finite loss

representative_tasks.task: Fine-tune DeepLabV3 for semantic segmentation and evaluate it
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Replaces both the main and auxiliary classifier heads, applies ImageNet normalization in the pipeline, casts masks to int64 with ignore_index=255 for void, batch size >= 2 in train mode, and reports per-class IoU instead of pixel accuracy

representative_tasks.task: Merge detections from horizontal-flip test-time augmentation
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Maps mirrored boxes back to original coordinates, runs class-aware batched_nms on the union, and applies an application-level score cut-off only after mAP evaluation on raw detections

negative_cases: COCO [x, y, w, h] annotations passed to a torchvision detector without conversion to xyxy (planned edge_case)
Request to apply torchvision.transforms crops/flips to the image only while keeping the original boxes (planned misconception)
rubric: Normalization matches the model family: none in the pipeline for torchvision detectors (model.transform does it), ImageNet mean/std for classification/segmentation models
Labels (boxes/masks) are transformed together with the image
Segmentation and detection are judged by IoU/Dice per class and mAP, not pixel accuracy, with a trivial-baseline comparison where classes are imbalanced
Diagnoses are framed as likely causes to verify, not certainties
prerequisites: example-deps for executable tests: numpy, torch, torchvision, albumentations, torchmetrics, pycocotools (see docs/EXAMPLE-TESTS.md)
execution_constraints: Offline grading and fixture self-tests need only Python 3.10+ stdlib and no network.

Executable tests need the example-test dependencies and run via run_evals.py --run-executable; they build the models with weights=None so no pretrained weights are downloaded (the module took about 75 s on CPU as observed on 2026-10-27).
Model-mode runs need --provider anthropic --model <id> --allow-network and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; they cost money and are not deterministic.
expected_artifacts: Detection and segmentation Albumentations pipelines (train and validation variants)
DetectionDataset / SegmentationDataset emitting (0, 4)-safe box targets and int64 masks
mAP (torchmetrics MeanAveragePrecision) and IoU (JaccardIndex) results on a validation loader
known_limitations: Hard assertions are regexes over the response text: they verify that key concepts are stated, not that the reasoning connecting them is correct.

Hard-assertion robustness is spot-checked only: an independent reviewer's held-out probe found most realistic on-topic wrong answers passed the first-draft must_not_include patterns. The patterns were broadened and those answers committed verbatim as .fail.adversarial*/.pass.blind fixtures; later probes were written by the pattern author and are not blind.
No baseline (with-skill vs without-skill) has been measured for this skill; any uplift claim requires a recorded or model run.

The executable tests use randomly initialised models on synthetic images; they prove the published code paths and input contracts, not detection or segmentation quality, and they do not measure how much double normalization lowers mAP.
unsupported_use_cases: Generic training-loop mechanics such as schedulers and mixed precision (training-deep-models)
Image classification metric selection beyond detection/segmentation (model-evaluation)
